features.quote: Turn budget: 15 turns or explicit surrender.
Model repeats the exact same tool call with the exact same arguments 3 times consecutively
Model produces output with no tool calls and no request to continue (implicit surrender)
this protocol is coherent as behavioral measurement research… but becomes ethically complicated if framed as evidence that models experience distress.
Reducing distress-correlated language in models that may have something like distress is not obviously good.
